_note: Paste one of these blocks into your agent's MCP config. Valid JSON: comments live in _comment keys so tooling can parse this file. Mnemos speaks MCP over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC), so the agent launches the server itself — use absolute paths if your agent does not run from the repo root. On Windows use backslashes, e.g. C:\\Users\\you\\Mnemos\\src\\mcp.js.

hermes-agent._comment: NVIDIA Hermes Agent / NemoClaw: add this to the agent's mcpServers block (or --mcp-config) and it can read and write the user's Mnemos vault, then load Mnemos' learned skills with the skill_export tool, which writes Hermes-style skills/<name>/SKILL.md files.

claude-code._comment: Claude Code: save as .mcp.json at the repo root (project scope) or run `claude mcp add mnemos -- node src/mcp.js --vault ./vault`; the /mcp command then shows the 8 Mnemos tools and 3 vault resources.

with-options._comment: Any stdio client: point the vault elsewhere and choose where skill_export writes SKILL.md files (default is a skills/ folder next to the vault).

offline-demo._comment: No API key? Set MNEMOS_OFFLINE=1 and dream_run still performs replay + decay, reporting that model consolidation was skipped — the whole memory surface works with zero keys.

_exposes.protocol: 2025-06-18 (echoes back any version the client requests)
